messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: trigger latency.p99 > 3000ms in prod-eu (alert_id=p-180999)
Alice: acked. I'll take on-call.
Bob: on-call handover: I'm on ramp, assigning to Alice.
Alice: seeing p95 creeping since 01:15 UTC; p99 spikes correlated with batch job window.
SRE-ops: can you run a quick tail-latency query and post numbers?
Alice: running: `SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) FROM requests WHERE env="prod-eu" AND ts > now() - 15m;` -> p95=1200ms, p99=3100ms
Charlie: any customer-facing errors? timeouts?
Alice: 504s up ~0.8% on bulk embedding endpoint; retries observed but most requests succeed after backoff.
Bob: checking kvcache metrics — evictions doubled in last 10m. Might be hotkey.
Alice: top key hotspot: /v1/embeddings (9.2% of traffic), single key with bursty large payloads.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalating to on-call lead in 5m if unresolved.
Bob: scaling sidecar pool to absorb queues: `kubectl scale deployment sidecar --replicas=8 -n prod-eu`
Alice: started controlled reroute: `routeset apply --from=default --to=fallback-lowlatency --pct=15` to divert heavy embedding traffic
Charlie: watching tail: p99 dropped 3.1s -> 2.0s after initial 15% reroute. Good signal.
Alice: if stable, ramp to 50% over 5m.
Bob: autoscaler delayed GPU spin-up by ~2m; doing manual scale while we stabilize.
SRE-ops: enabling throttle for background/batch embedding jobs to free headroom on hot path.
Alice: applied prefix/KV caching for embedding requests (runbook step).
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by Alice.
Charlie: customer impact note: intermittent delays for bulk embedding workloads; narrow customer set affected, support has been notified to flag tickets.
Alice: creating incident ticket INC-2024-432 with timeline and mitigation actions.
Bob: next actions — keep reroute, monitor tokenized queue length, plan full rollback if errors increase.
Alice: logs snippet: `grep 'embedding' /var/log/sidecar/requests.log | tail -n 50` shows bursts of 502s coincident with kvcache evictions.
SRE-ops: proposal: change kvcache eviction policy to LFU for a 10m window to reduce churn. Approve?
Alice: yes, apply LFU now.
Bob: LFU policy applied; evictions stabilized in metrics.
Charlie: p99 now ~1100ms, p95 ~420ms, 504s dropped back to baseline.
Alice: de-escalating — keeping monitoring for 30m per runbook.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident marked resolved (auto-close scheduled in 30m).
Alice: filing postmortem draft; follow-ups: better kvcache partitioning, traffic shaping for large embedding keys, and autoscaler tuning for GPU spin-up latency.
Charlie: thanks team :thumbsup: nice quick mitigation.
Bob: great work — handing off to daytime on-call in 25m.
Alice: handing off to @dan at 02:10 UTC; notes and links posted in INC-2024-432.
Dan: ack, I'll take over monitoring and post any regressions.
